title: Recombination heating of an illuminated n-type bar: drift-diffusion -> heat by field_transfer (analytic)
description:
The bar of semiconductor/analytic_minority_diffusion_length (N_D = 1e23 1/m^3, 10 um, one ohmic contact on [0, 20 nm], uniform generation G = 1e27 1/(m^3 s), SRH tau_srh + radiative B = 1e-16 m^3/s) plus a heat physics (k = 130 W/(m K), T = T0 on the x_lo face, other faces insulated). An enabled field_transfer turns the net recombination into heat, Q = E_g q R (each pair releases the gap energy E_g = 1.12 eV; the contact cells recombine and heat nothing). Stationary study (drift-diffusion, then heat as a sink: one pass), sweep tau_srh = 1e-10..3e-8 s.
Analytic (low injection): tau_eff = 1 / (1 / tau_srh + B N_D), L = sqrt(mu_p V_T tau_eff), r(x) = 1 - cosh((Lx - x) / L) / cosh(W / L) (W = Lx - x_c, x_c = w_contact - dx / 2 the innermost contact cell centre), Q = Q0 r on x > w_contact with Q0 = E_g q G. Heat sink power per m of depth P_sink = Q0 Ly (W - L tanh(W / L)); the rise theta(x) = (Q0 / k) [w_c (S - L sinh(S / L) / C) + (S^2 - (Lx - x)^2) / 2 - L^2 (cosh(S / L) - cosh((Lx - x) / L)) / C] on the free part (S = Lx - w_contact, C = cosh(W / L)), theta_end = theta(Lx) -> Q0 (Lx^2 - w_c^2) / (2 k) as L -> 0. The rise is small (~7e-5 K): it is compared as heat_T_rise (solved in float64, not the float32 T).
Derived values tab: P_sink (integral of heat_Q), theta_end (max of heat_T_rise, at the last cell centre: (dx / Lx)^2 below theta(Lx)). Expect ~1e-4 (low-injection corrections ~dp / N_D, discretisation ~(dx / L)^2).
Sweep tab: P_sink and theta_end versus tau_srh with their dashed curves (both fall as the holes diffuse to the contact and recombine there, out of the heated bar).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 3e-8 s): T_rise_profile, theta(x) along the free part of the bar. Field tab: heat T, T_rise, Q and semiconductor P, recombination.

parameters.name: tau_srh
parameters.description: SRH lifetime of both carriers in s (the sweep runs 1e-10..3e-8 s)

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (semiconductor temperature and heat T0)

parameters.name: E_g
parameters.description: band gap in eV: heat per recombined pair E_g q

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: width of the ohmic contact at x_lo

parameters.name: x_c
parameters.description: centre of the innermost held contact cell (excess holes 0 there)

parameters.name: W_free
parameters.description: diffusion width from x_c to the insulated end in m

parameters.name: Q0
parameters.description: heat density of full local recombination in W/m^3 (1.8e8)

parameters.name: P_sink_ref
parameters.description: analytic recombination heat per m of depth in W/m

parameters.name: theta_end_ref
parameters.description: analytic temperature rise at the insulated end x = Lx in K

analytic_curves.name: T_rise_profile
analytic_curves.expression: Q0/k_si*(w_contact*(S_heat - L_D*sinh(S_heat/L_D)/C_W) + (S_heat**2 - (Lx - x)**2)/2 - L_D**2*(cosh(S_heat/L_D) - cosh((Lx - x)/L_D))/C_W)
